QuestInfo.name: Memory Lane
QuestInfo.0: #p2400005# and #p2400006# went on the hunt to figure out which of them was corrupted, and to cure themselves. Their first stop was the #b#p2480001##k.
QuestInfo.1: The #p2480001# told them that only #p2400005# or #p2400006# would be able to identify corruption. He suggested an item called the #b#t2431836##k in #b#MDmirrorD_328_0_##k. The #rDodos#k there would carry them...\r\n\r\n#r(Tip: Forfeit the quest if you need to restart.)#k
QuestInfo.2: The #t2431836# gave #p2400005# and #p2400006# visions of all the happy times they had experienced during their travels, but no signs of corruption. The fond memories had chased away any memories of the dark times, and #p2480001# said that he could not help.

0.0: Only you would know which of you was corrupted... You, and the one who did it to you. But a glimpse into the past might help.

yes.0: Visit Memory Lane, and hunt the eater of memories, the #rDodo#k. The shards it drops may give you insight.

1.0: You have nothing but beautiful memories? Then your dark pasts have been overwhelmed by nostalgia for the time you've enjoyed. I'm afraid I cannot help you.
1.1: If only nostalgia could solve problems...

item.0: Visit Memory Lane, and hunt the eater of memories, the #rDodo#k. The shards it drops may give you insight.
